title: PromotionEvidence
description: A gate-by-gate promotion review record for a primitive or group: which promotion gates were checked, what evidence backs each verdict, and whether the subject is eligible for the target level. This object records evidence for a promotion decision; it never performs promotion itself and never serves truth. A subject with any failed or pending required gate stays blocked.

subject_id.description: The primitive (prim:) or group (grp:) under promotion review.

evidence_refs.description: Run directories, receipt ids, test modules, or docs proving the gate verdict was observed, not asserted.

blocking_gates.description: Gate names currently preventing promotion; must be empty when overall_status is eligible.
